Game Overview

Tile Pop puts players into a match-3 experience centered on pop through adorable farm tiles in Tile Pop. Match three identical crops, clear the board, and unlock increasingly challenging puzzles. Climb levels for more fun with tricky tile combinations. When stuck, use shuffles and hints to continue your delightful farm journey. Can you conquer the cutest farm puzzles?
